title: A normalized cone on the identity characterizes a final object
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, right-pinched mapping spaces and weak contractibility as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For simplicial sets $X,Y$, define their join by $(X\star Y)_r=X_r\amalg Y_r\amalg\coprod_{u+v+1=r}X_u\times Y_v$, with simplicial operators induced by restricting the ordered concatenation of the $X$-vertices followed by the $Y$-vertices. Write $X^{\triangleright}=X\star\Delta^0$, with $X$ as its base and the additional vertex as its cone point. Let $J$ be a quasicategory and $t\in J_0$. Then $\operatorname{Map}_J(j,t)$ is weakly contractible for every $j\in J_0$ if and only if there exists a simplicial map $F:J^{\triangleright}\to J$ whose restriction to the base $J$ is $\operatorname{id}_J$, which sends the cone point to $t$, and whose restriction to the edge $\{t\}^{\triangleright}\cong\Delta^1$ is the constant simplicial map at $t$ (the degenerate edge $\operatorname{id}_t$).

source.place: Kerodon Corollary 4.7.3.21 (02J4), assertion (1), expressed through the defining join universal property of the slice: a section J to J over t is a map from the right cone restricting to the identity; the prescribed value at t is the degenerate edge. For the right-pinched mapping-space convention see Construction 4.6.5.1 and Propositions 4.6.5.5 and 4.6.5.10. These are Kerodon references, not Stacks tags.
